text: Mental-health struggles are common among young people, and asking for help is strength, not weakness. Encourage your teen to talk to a school or university counsellor, a doctor or a mental-health professional, and save your country's mental-health helpline on both your phones.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: re-addressed to the parent (the tip spoke to the teen); the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance.
